create_embed_module: create an Embed module with vocab_size and embed_dim to embed tokens in a low-dimensional space
create_embed_existing_vocab: create an Embed module initialized with an existing vocabulary matrix for pre-trained embeddings
create_embed_densify_gradients: create an Embed module with densify_gradients enabled to convert IndexedSlices gradients to dense tensors
calculate_embedding_dim: calculate a reasonable embedding dimension for a given vocabulary size using the rule of thumb formula
apply_dense_gradient: apply dense_gradient to convert embedding lookup gradients from IndexedSlices to dense tensors
